text: Take a moment to settle into a comfortable position.
Allow your body to be supported.
Let your attention arrive gently right here, right now.
Notice the natural rhythm of your breathing.
No need to change it.
Just feel the breath moving in and out, in its own steady way.
Bringing awareness to the weight of your body, the contact beneath you, and the calming sensation
of being held softly.
With each breath, the body begins to organize itself.
soften as the whole nervous system settles into a slower rhythm.
Notice the expansion of the chest, a calm even pace begins to emerge.
Now bring attention to the center of your body, the space around the heart.
Earth, Movement, Presence.
There is a natural intelligence here, a steady rhythm that knows how to regulate and balance.
As you breathe, allow the steadiness to spread, through the shoulders, down the arms,
into the hands,
through the spine,
The hips
The legs
The feet
Our whole body begins to move together as one system, balanced, coherent, at ease.
Thoughts may come and go, that's natural.
Each time you notice a thought, allow yourself to return to the awareness of your breath.
A quiet steadiness is available right now.
You don't need to fix anything.
Your system already knows how to return to balance.
Feel the rhythm of your breath, smooth, grounded, reliable.
With each moment, clarity begins to settle in.
Emotions find their natural level.
The mind becomes calm and spacious.
You are here, present, grounded.
Take one more slow, comfortable breath.
Let the body fully arrive into this moment.
When you're ready, allow your awareness to gently expand, carrying this steadiness with
with you into the rest of your day.
